header.running_head: What Masaajid are Built for and what the Sahabah (RA) did therein

blocks.text: Several incidents describing how the Sahabah (RA) slept in the Masjid has passed in the chapter discussing hospitality towards guests.

When Hadhrat Hasan (RA) was asked about people taking their siesta in the Masjid, he replied, "I have seen Hadhrat Uthmaan bin Affaan (RA) taking his siesta in the Masjid during the period when he was Khalifah." [^1]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) said, "When we were still youngsters during the time of Rasulullaah ﷺ, we used to spend the night at the Masjid." He also said, "After gathering for the Jumu'ah salaah, we would return to the Masjid to have our siesta." [^2]

Hadhrat Umar (RA) once said, "When any of you has been sitting too long in the Masjid, there is no harm in him lying down on his side because this is the most appropriate manner to prevent his sitting from tiring him." [^3]

Hadhrat Khaleed bin Abu Is'haaq narrates that he once asked Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) about sleeping in the Masjid. Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) replied, "There is no harm in it if you are sleeping (to gain strength) for performing salaah or Tawaaf." [^4]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Hastens to the Masjid when the Wind Blows Fiercely and During an Eclipse

Hadhrat Jaabir (RA) says, "Whenever the wind blew fiercely at night, Rasulullaah ﷺ hastened towards the Masjid and would remain there until the wind subsided. He would also hasten to the place of salaah whenever the sun or the moon eclipsed." [^5]
Hadhrat Ataa reports that a Sahabi by the name of Hadhrat Ya'la bin Umayyah (RA) used to sit for even a moment in the Masjid with the intention of performing I'tikaaf. [^6]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Makes a Delegation from the Thaqeef stay in the Masjid

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Atiyya bin Sufyaan bin Abdullaah (RA)
blocks.text: Hadhrat Atiyya bin Sufyaan bin Abdullaah (RA) narrates, "When a delegation from the Thaqeef came to Rasulullaah ﷺ one Ramadhaan, Rasulullaah ﷺ pitched a tent for them in the Masjid. When they accepted Islaam, they started to fast with Rasulullaah ﷺ." [^7]

Hadhrat Uthmaan bin Abil Aas (RA) narrates that when the Thaqeef delegation came to Rasulullaah ﷺ, he accommodated them in the Masjid so that it would soften their hearts. The rest of the narration has already passed in the chapter concerning Da'wah towards Allah and His Rasool ﷺ[^8]
